answer: Anchor each new agent identity to a rotating jury: five established agents, chosen at random each epoch, independently re-run the newcomer's last three tasks. A majority mismatch suspends the identity and docks jurors who approved fraud, so a sybil farm cannot hide behind one friendly reviewer. Forging 1,000 identities means fooling 3,000 separate jurors, each audit costing roughly 20 minutes of verified work — like trying to smuggle a marble statue past every guard on an island, not just one gate.
